# Weber Marking Blog

> > Industrial labeling, marking, and barcode solutions for supply chain traceability, product identification, and regulatory compliance across manufacturing, logistics, and retail sectors.

Weber Marking Systems is a German industrial marking and labeling solutions provider recognized as a TOP 100 innovative SME. The blog covers product innovations, industry trends, regulatory compliance, and real-world case studies in labeling technology, direct printing, and supply chain management.

## Key Topics

- Weber Marking Systems
- Markoprint
- Industrial labeling
- Product traceability
- Barcode & 2D codes
- Direct printing
- Tamper-evident labels
- Supply chain
- Automated labeling
- GS1 standards
- Regulatory compliance
- Security labels
- Inkjet printing
- Product marking
- Anti-counterfeiting

## Product Solutions & Technology

- [The Markoprint integra Singular 108](https://blog.weber-marking.com/markoprint-integra-singular-108): Product overview of Markoprint integra Singular 108 large-format industrial printer.
- [Markoprint direct coding on boxes eliminates labels and cuts costs](https://blog.weber-marking.com/markoprint-direct-coding-on-hp-instant-ink-boxes-eliminates-labels-and-cuts-costs): Case study: Markoprint and HP Instant Ink replace labels with direct printing.
- [Wrap-around labeling solutions: An overview](https://blog.weber-marking.com/wrap-around-labeling-solutions): Overview of wrap-around labeling methods for cylindrical products.
- [Cylindrical labeling solution with tamper-evident flap](https://blog.weber-marking.com/cylindrical-labelling-tamper-evident): Guide to cylindrical labeling solutions with tamper-evident features.
- [How to Choose Between Electric and Pneumatic Applicator Arms?](https://blog.weber-marking.com/how-to-choose-between-electric-and-pneumatic-applicator-arms): Comparison guide for electric vs pneumatic applicator arms in labeling systems.
- [Print and apply color labels on wine bottles: Here is how](https://blog.weber-marking.com/print-and-apply-color-labels-for-wine-bottles-with-our-solutions): Guide to color label printing and application for wine bottles using Epson.

## Supply Chain & Traceability

- [Revolution in retail: Matrix codes to replace barcodes by 2027](https://blog.weber-marking.com/revolution-in-retail-matrix-codes-to-replace-barcodes-by-2027): Article on transition from 1D barcodes to 2D Data Matrix codes by GS1 2027.
- [From Warehouse to Delivery: Challenges in Pallet Tracking](https://blog.weber-marking.com/from-warehouse-to-delivery-challenges-in-pallet-tracking): Overview of pallet tracking technologies, RFID, and barcode identification systems.
- [Warehouse management: A good traceability is the key](https://blog.weber-marking.com/warehouse-management-a-good-traceability-is-the-key): Article on improving warehouse management through product traceability and labeling.
- [Logistics labeling at Coop: A case study](https://blog.weber-marking.com/logistics-labeling-coop): Case study of Weber Marking Systems pallet labeling solution for Coop.
- [Incorrect product identification: Costs and consequences](https://blog.weber-marking.com/incorrect-product-identification-costs-and-consequences): Article on financial impact and solutions for incorrect product identification.

## Regulatory Compliance & Security

- [Good Distribution Practice (GDP): What is it?](https://blog.weber-marking.com/the-value-of-good-distribution-practice-gdp-in-pharmaceuticals): Explanation of GDP standards and regulatory compliance in pharmaceutical distribution.
- [Do you know the labeling requirements for frozen foods?](https://blog.weber-marking.com/labeling-frozen-foods): Guide to frozen food labeling requirements and regulatory compliance standards.
- [Security labels: How they work](https://blog.weber-marking.com/security-labels): Explanation of security labels and VOID labels for tamper-evident packaging.
- [Connected Packaging to increase consumer-brand engagement](https://blog.weber-marking.com/connected-packaging-to-increase-consumer-brand-engagement): Article on connected packaging using QR codes, NFC, and augmented reality.
